body_lead: Gujarat High Court seeks responses from Centre, Gujarat government on PIL over misuse of AI-generated deepfakes The PIL, filed by advocate Vikas Vijay Nair, sought legal reforms and regulatory directions to protect Constitutional and statutory authorities against the misuse of AI in the creation and circulation of fake and manipulated videos and photographs. The Gujarat High Court on Tuesday issued notices to the Central and state governments on a PIL concerning the misuse of artificial intelligence to create deepfakes and synthetically generated content targeting Constitutional authorities.
